name: Buzz
summary: Free desktop app that transcribes audio and video on your own computer using OpenAI's open Whisper model.
gains: Private: audio never leaves your computer
tradeoffs: Slower on older laptops without a good GPU
No live meeting bot or AI summaries built in (pair it with a local AI model for summaries)
setupSteps: Download Buzz from its GitHub releases page and install it
Drop in an audio or video file
Pick a Whisper model ("small" is a good start; "medium" is more accurate but slower)
Click Run, then export as TXT or SRT
Optional: paste the transcript into your local AI to get a summary
